details.name: Improvement: root-cause share
details.message: Fixing causes: 57% of the 292 cards finished this week fixed a cause or added a system, the rest fixed one more case of a repeat problem (last week 56%). 37 problems keep coming back; 37 have a card to fix the cause. 4 fixes claimed to stop a repeat, and it came back anyway. An independent check of 8 fixes from this week, reading only the code, found 6 of 8 fixed the cause.

details.name: Improvement: done claims that held
details.message: Done claims that held: 93% (690 of 744) over 30 days, 87% (263 of 301) over 7 days; 10 more could not be checked on the recheck machine.
